headline: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Limited announces rights issue of 1.25 crore equity shares at ₹264 per share
sum: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Limited announced a rights issue of 1,24,99,669 equity shares at ₹264 per share (par + ₹254 premium) in the ratio of 7:40, expected to raise approximately ₹32.97 crore gross proceeds.
implication: Rights issues under ICDR 2018 require careful attention to entitlement ratios, pricing justification (especially where premium exceeds par by >10×), and shareholder communication; the 7:40 dilution ratio and aggressive premium merit scrutiny under preferential issue disclosure norms.
detail: The Board of Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Limited at its 20 August 2026 meeting approved the issuance of 1,24,99,669 equity shares on a rights basis (7 shares for every 40 held) at ₹264 per share, comprising face value and a ₹254 premium. The gross capital raise is approximately ₹32.97 crore. Rights issues are a lower-friction capital raise mechanism relative to public offers, but pricing and ratio justification must be disclosed to shareholders in the offer document under SEBI ICDR.
